summary.name: Maccy
summary.one_liner: Maccy is a lightweight, open source clipboard manager for macOS that keeps your copy history searchable from the keyboard.
use_cases: Recalling previously copied text on a Mac
Searching clipboard history by typing and pressing Enter
Keeping copied passwords out of clipboard history
Using a minimal clipboard tool without extra features
Reviewing or modifying clipboard manager source code
summary.what_it_does: Maccy runs on macOS and stores your clipboard history on your own computer. You open it and type to search your entire history, which the page says takes a fraction of a second, then press Enter to choose an item without using the mouse. If a password manager removes a copied password from the clipboard, Maccy removes it from its history too. The interface uses native macOS UI and is intentionally minimal. The source code is on GitHub under the MIT license.
notable: Keyboard-first search of clipboard history, selected with Enter
Open source under MIT license with source on GitHub
Native macOS UI with minimal footprint
caveats: Only available for macOS, according to the page
Page is mostly promotional and gives few technical details such as exact version or install method
